text: /* rev-on-scroll */.rev-on-scroll { opacity: 0 !important; transition: all 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important; will-change: transform, opacity !important; } .rev--up { transform: translateY(50px) !important; } .rev--down { transform: translateY(-50px) !important; } .rev--left { transform: translateX(-80px) !important; } .rev--right { transform: translateX(80px) !important; } .rev--zoom { transform: scale(0.85) !important; } .rev-on-scroll.active { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }/* /rev-on-scroll */
